The /live/export/orders API provides a response in the following format:

200 Success

text/csv - Orders of the live deployments of the project, sorted by time.
content string
One row per order. The Time column is in UTC.
Example 
Deploy,Time,Symbol,Price,Quantity,Type,Status,Value,Tag
L-6e9d8a78f5af89d401f630585be90e43,2026-10-08T14:20:04.8005773Z,SPY,672.35,10,"Market","Filled",6723.5,""

401 Authentication Error

UnauthorizedError Model - Unauthorized response from the API. Key is missing, invalid, or timestamp is too old for hash.
www_authenticate string
Header
